HowItWorks.metaDescription: How to find remote AI-training jobs and track your applications on {name}, for free.
HowItWorks.title: How {name} works
HowItWorks.intro: {name} brings remote AI-training jobs into one place, tailors your resume to each one, and gives you a free board to track every application, so nothing slips through the cracks.

browse.title: 1. Browse jobs
browse.body: The job feed lists open roles from Mercor, micro1, Invisible, Welo Data, xAI and RemoExperts, refreshed every few hours. Search by title and filter by platform, field, language, country and minimum pay. You don't need an account to browse.

account.title: 2. Create a free account
account.body: Enter your email and we send you a sign-in link. There's no password to remember. A short profile (your field, languages, country and availability) takes about a minute and can be skipped.

track.title: 3. Track jobs you care about
track.body: Tap Track this on any job and it lands in the Saved column of your board. You can also add your own cards for applications made elsewhere.

tailor.title: 4. Tailor your resume to each job
tailor.body: Upload your resume once on the Resume page. On any job, choose Tailor My Resume for This Job and paste the job description: in about a minute you get a version written for that job, using only your real experience. Review it, edit anything, then save it and download it as Word or PDF.

board.title: 5. Move cards as you progress
board.body: Your board has six stages: Saved, Applied, Assessment, Interviewing, Offered and Rejected. Drag cards on a computer, or use the Move menu on any device. Open a card to add notes, the date you applied and a follow-up date.

remind.title: 6. Get follow-up reminders
remind.body: Set a follow-up date on a card and we email you that day, so you remember to check in or chase a reply.

alerts.title: 7. Get job alerts
alerts.body: Filter the feed, tap Get alerts and choose daily or weekly. We email you new jobs that match. Change or stop any email in Email settings, or with the unsubscribe link in every email.

free.title: Free, and how we earn
free.body: {name} is free to use. When you apply through our links, the platform may pay us a referral fee if you're hired. It never costs you anything and doesn't change which jobs we show.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of {name} (the "Service"), operated by {operator} of {location} ("we", "us"). By using the Service you agree to them. If you don't agree, please don't use the Service.

service.heading: 1. What the Service is
service.body: The Service lists remote AI-training job opportunities published by third-party platforms, such as Mercor and micro1, and offers free tools to track your applications, set reminders and receive job alerts. We are not an employer, recruiter or staffing agency, and we are not part of the hiring process of any platform.

eligibility.heading: 2. Who can use it
eligibility.body: You must be at least 18 years old and able to form a binding contract to create an account. You are responsible for your use of the Service and for keeping access to your email account secure, since sign-in links are sent there.

listings.heading: 3. Job listings
listings.body:
Listings come from the platforms that post them. We show a short summary and link to the platform for full details. We do our best to keep listings accurate and current, but we don't guarantee that any job is available, that its pay or requirements are correct, or that you will be hired. Always check the details on the platform before applying.

Applications, contracts and payments for any job are between you and the platform. Their own terms apply.

referrals.heading: 4. Referral links
referrals.body: Some links to platforms include our referral code. If you join or are hired through them, the platform may pay us a fee. This never costs you anything. See our Affiliate Disclosure for details.

content.heading: 5. Your content
content.body:
Notes, cards, saved searches and profile answers you add belong to you. You give us permission to store and process them only to provide the Service to you. Don't add content that is unlawful or that you have no right to use.

Tailored resumes are drafts written by AI from the resume you upload. Check every detail before you use one: you're responsible for what you send to a platform, and we don't promise that any resume will pass a platform's screening.

use.heading: 6. Acceptable use
use.body: Don't misuse the Service. For example, don't try to access other people's accounts, interfere with the Service's operation, send it automated traffic at a volume a person couldn't, or use it to break the law or any platform's terms.

availability.heading: 7. Availability and changes
availability.body: The Service is provided free of charge. We may change, suspend or stop any part of it at any time. We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms. You can stop using the Service and ask us to delete your account at any time.

warranty.heading: 8. No warranty
warranty.body: The Service is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

liability.heading: 9. Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential loss, or for any loss arising from a third-party platform, a job listing, or a missed email. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or your rights as a consumer under the law of the country where you live.

law.heading: 10. Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Mexico. Any dispute will be handled by the competent courts of {region}, Mexico, unless the law of the country where you live gives you the right to bring a claim there.

changes.heading: 11. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. We'll change the date at the top of this page, and for important changes we'll let account holders know by email. Continuing to use the Service after a change means you accept the new terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains what personal data {name} and our daily newsletter, {newsletter}, collect, why, and the choices you have. {operator}, of {location}, is responsible for your data.

collect.heading: 1. What we collect
collect.body:
If you only browse, we don't ask for any personal data.

If you create an account, we keep: your email address; the profile answers you choose to give (field of work, skills, languages, country, availability and target pay); your tracker cards, notes, dates and stage history; your platform statuses; your saved searches; and your email preferences.

If you forward emails to your private tracking address, our email provider (Resend) receives them and we read them once to update your board. We keep only the sender's domain and the subject line, never the email itself.

If you use resume tailoring, we keep your Master Profile (the text of the resume you upload or paste, never the file itself, and the core skills and evidence you add), the tailored resumes you create, and a record of each tailoring request (when, for which job, and how much it cost to run, never its content).

When you click Apply, we record which job was clicked and when (and your account, if you're signed in), so we can measure referrals. Our hosting providers also keep standard technical logs, such as IP addresses, for security.

If you subscribe to {newsletter}, we keep your email address, when you subscribed, and where you signed up (for example, the page or link you came from). When you subscribe through a form on this site, the form sends your email address straight to our newsletter provider; we also count the signup, recording only which form it was and the campaign tags in the page address, never who you are. Our newsletter provider records whether each issue is delivered and whether you open it or click its links, so we can see which parts readers find useful.

use.heading: 2. Why we use it
use.body:
We use your data to provide the Service: to sign you in, show your board, send the emails you ask for (sign-in links, the welcome email, follow-up reminders, job alerts and the newsletter), match jobs to your profile, keep the Service secure, and understand how referral links are used and which parts of the newsletter readers find useful. We don't sell your data, and we don't use it for advertising.

We rely on providing the Service you requested (contract) and our legitimate interest in running and securing it. Where the law requires consent, for example for optional emails and the newsletter, you can withdraw it at any time in Email settings or with the unsubscribe link at the bottom of every newsletter.

share.heading: 3. Who we share it with
share.body:
We use a small number of service providers who process data on our behalf: Supabase (database and sign-in), Netlify (website hosting), Resend (email delivery), Beehiiv (newsletter delivery and the newsletter website at {newsletterDomain}) and Stripe (payments for The AI Remote Work Playbook). When you buy the Playbook, Stripe collects your payment details on its own checkout page; we never see your card. We receive your name, email address and country from Stripe, and use your email only to send your download link and answer refund requests. They may process data in the United States or other countries, under contracts and safeguards that protect it.

When you apply through our links, the platform (for example Mercor or micro1) receives our referral code. It doesn't receive your data from us. Anything you give a platform is covered by its own privacy policy.

We use an AI provider, Anthropic. It helps research and draft the newsletter from public information, such as job listings and news, and for that it never receives your personal data. When you ask us to tailor your resume, we send Anthropic your master resume, the core skills and evidence on your Master Profile, and the job description, so it can write the tailored version. Anthropic processes them on our behalf, keeps them only for a limited time under its own data policies, and doesn't use them to train its models.

keep.heading: 4. How long we keep it
keep.body:
We keep your account data for as long as your account exists. If you ask us to delete your account, we delete your personal data within 30 days, apart from anything we must keep by law. Click records not linked to an account may be kept for statistics.

You can delete your Master Profile, and any tailored resume, at any time from the Master Profile page; they are deleted with your account too.

We keep your newsletter subscription until you unsubscribe. After that we stop emailing you, but we may keep your email address on a do-not-send list so we never email you again by mistake.

rights.heading: 5. Your rights
rights.body: Depending on where you live, including under the EU and UK GDPR and Mexico's personal data protection law (your ARCO rights), you can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to or restrict its use, or receive a copy. You can stop optional emails at any time in Email settings, and unsubscribe from the newsletter with the link in every issue. To make a request, email us at {email}. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.

security.heading: 6. Security
security.body: Data is encrypted in transit, and access to each account's data is restricted to that account. The people who run the Service (the operator and one administrator) can see account email addresses and account activity, only to operate the Service and answer support requests. No system is perfectly secure, so please keep access to your email account safe.

children.heading: 7. Children
children.body: The Service is for people aged 18 and over. We don't knowingly collect data from children.

changes.heading: 8. Changes
changes.body: We may update this notice. We'll change the date at the top, and for important changes we'll let account holders and newsletter subscribers know by email.

cookies.title: Cookie Notice
cookies.intro: {name} uses only a few cookies, all needed for the site to work. We don't use advertising or analytics cookies, so we don't show a cookie banner.

which.heading: 1. The cookies we use
which.body:
Sign-in cookies (names starting with "sb-"): keep you signed in. They are set when you sign in and removed when you sign out.

Language cookie (NEXT_LOCALE): remembers the site language.

Introduction cookie (intro_dismissed): remembers that you hid the welcome introduction, for up to a year.

Playbook card cookie (playbook_card_dismissed): remembers that you hid the Playbook card on your dashboard, for up to a year.

third.heading: 2. Third-party cookies
third.body:
We don't place third-party cookies. When you follow a link to a job platform, that platform's own cookie policy applies on its site.

Our newsletter's website, {newsletterDomain}, is hosted by Beehiiv, which may set its own cookies there. Beehiiv's cookie policy applies on that site.

control.heading: 3. Your choices
control.body: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block the sign-in cookies, you won't be able to stay signed in. If we ever add optional cookies, such as analytics, we'll ask for your consent first.

affiliates.title: Affiliate Disclosure
affiliates.intro: {name} is free because some links to job platforms are referral links.

how.heading: How it works
how.body: When you click Apply, you go to the platform through our link, which may add our referral code. Today that applies to Mercor and micro1; links to other platforms, such as Invisible or Welo Data, are plain links with no referral code. If you join or are hired through the link, the platform may pay us a referral fee under its own referral program.

you.heading: What it means for you
you.body: It never costs you anything, and it doesn't change your pay or your chances of being hired. Jobs are listed and sorted the same way whether or not they earn us a fee. We mark referral links with a short notice next to the Apply button.

pain.title: Sound familiar?
pain.lead: Thousands of people are applying for AI-training work. Most get stuck at the same points.

items.silence: You apply to platform after platform and never hear back.
items.assessment: You fail an assessment and nobody tells you why.
items.interview: An AI interviewer asks you to "walk through your reasoning" and you freeze.
items.scams: You can't tell which opportunities are real and which are scams.
items.resume: You rewrite your resume for every listing and still don't know what they want.

pain.close: None of this is about talent. It's about knowing how the process works. That's what this playbook teaches.

advantage.title: Your non-AI experience is your unfair advantage
advantage.lead: AI work isn't one job. It's a family of tasks: evaluating answers, ranking responses, fact-checking, writing examples, reviewing code, testing for safety. Models still need human judgment to tell right from merely fluent, and that judgment comes from experience you may already have.

bilingual.body: Catch translation errors and cultural mismatches that models miss.

sample.lead: Every simulation asks you to judge first, then compare with the expert judgment. Here's the first one.
sample.label: Simulation 1 · Instruction following
sample.prompt: “Give two reasons to keep a project tracker.”
sample.a: “It records application status and reminds you of follow-up actions.”
sample.b: “It improves organization, boosts confidence, helps networking, makes resumes better, and guarantees you never miss an opportunity.”
sample.question: Which response is better, and why?
sample.judgment: A follows the request for exactly two reasons and avoids an unsupported guarantee. B gives more than was asked for and makes an absolute claim that can't be justified.

audience.forTitle: This playbook is for you if…

for.switcher: You want flexible, remote, paid work and you're open to something new.
for.expert: You have professional or academic experience and want to put it to work training AI.
for.bilingual: You speak more than one language, or work in a field like law, medicine, finance or education.
for.stuck: You've applied before and got stuck at an assessment or AI interview.

not.rich: You want guaranteed income or a get-rich-quick scheme. The book is honest: work can be meaningful, and it can also be irregular.
not.shortcuts: You want to fake qualifications or bypass country restrictions. The Playbook teaches the opposite: truthful, specific applications win.

author.title: About the author
author.name: Cris Lopez, PhD
author.body: “I did not write this book based on theory. I wrote it based on over 500 hours of paid, hands-on work evaluating and training AI models.”
author.more: Combining decades of academic rigor and executive leadership, Cris built a systematic approach to the new AI workforce: landing roles, passing rigorous assessments, and receiving regular inquiries and offers from platforms like Mercor, micro1, Ethos and Alignerr, after going through the onboarding of dozens more.

format.q: What do I get, and how?
format.a: A {pages}-page PDF. After checkout you go straight to your download page, and we email you the link too. It works on any phone, tablet or computer.

experience.q: Do I need AI or tech experience?
experience.a: No. Many roles center on evaluation, writing, language and subject knowledge. The book shows how to translate the experience you already have, truthfully.

guarantee.q: Does it guarantee I'll get hired?
guarantee.a: No, and be wary of anyone who promises that. Platforms choose who they accept, and work can be irregular. The Playbook gives you the process, the practice and the preparation that make you a much stronger applicant.

platforms.a: It focuses on Mercor and micro1 (including micro1's AI recruiter, Zara), and covers others to research such as Alignerr, Ethos, DataAnnotation, Outlier, TELUS Digital AI and RWS TrainAI. The book isn't affiliated with or endorsed by any of them.

countries.q: Can I use it outside the United States?
countries.a: Yes. Many roles are open internationally, and the book has a checklist for location, payments and taxes so you can confirm eligibility before you apply.

dashboard.a: Yes. AI Remote Work Dashboard is free to use, with or without the book. Some platforms pay us a referral fee when you're hired through our links; you never pay anything.

refund.q: What if it isn't for me?
refund.a: Email {email} within {days} days of your purchase for a full refund.

payment.a: Checkout runs on Stripe, which handles cards for millions of businesses. We never see or store your card details.
